paragraphs.heading: The shape of Leo’s 2026
paragraphs.text: 2026 asks you to separate being seen from being known, and to value work and affection that would matter even without an audience. The practical through-line is simple: creative authority deepens when attention serves a real purpose. Your first dated checkpoint for study and wider horizons is Neptune entering Aries on January 26. Jupiter entering Leo on June 30 changes the longer-range emphasis around identity and first moves, while Jupiter stationing retrograde in Leo on December 13 gives identity and first moves a final review point. None of those dates assigns an outcome; compare study and wider horizons and identity and first moves with what is actually happening, then keep the choice that fits your circumstances.

paragraphs.heading: January to March · Shared commitments and intimacy
paragraphs.text: The first quarter is for sorting shared commitments and intimacy from study and wider horizons instead of letting whichever feels urgent set the whole pace. Choose a center for each season and allow supporting work to remain supporting work. A longer chapter starts on January 26, 2026 as Neptune enters Aries, shifting the plan around travel, learning, beliefs, and long-term plans; test the larger belief against study, distance, or direct experience. A progress check for career, reputation, and public responsibilities arrives on February 4, 2026, when Uranus stations direct in Taurus; choose the finished work, standard, or responsibility you are prepared to make visible. A longer chapter starts on February 14, 2026 as Saturn enters Aries, shifting the plan around travel, learning, beliefs, and long-term plans; test the larger belief against study, distance, or direct experience. Mark February 17, 2026 for a review of partners and one-to-one relationships with the solar eclipse in Aquarius; identify a beginning worth defining and state the term that is still vague and give the other person a real chance to answer it. Circle February 26, 2026 for a second look at shared finances, debts, intimacy, and trust: Mercury stations retrograde in Pisces, so name what is shared, owed, private, or difficult to divide. Mark March 3, 2026 for a review of your money, possessions, and priorities with the lunar eclipse in Virgo; identify a result or limit worth naming and put a number beside the cost, the available capacity, and the value you expect in return. Use March 11, 2026 to decide what can resume around rest, privacy, and unfinished matters: Jupiter stations direct in Cancer, so leave time for rest and finishing something privately. A progress check for shared finances, debts, intimacy, and trust arrives on March 20, 2026, when Mercury stations direct in Pisces; list what is shared, what is owed, and what must remain private before making the next commitment.

paragraphs.heading: April to June · Identity and first moves
paragraphs.text: Spring tests how identity and first moves can move without weakening partnerships and agreements; make one decision concrete enough to revisit. From April 26, 2026, Uranus enters Gemini and keeps friends, groups, and plans for the future in the longer-range plan, so choose one friendship or group plan to follow up on, and agree on a time for the next step. A slower pass through partners and one-to-one relationships starts on May 6, 2026, when Pluto stations retrograde in Aquarius; put the agreement or disagreement directly on the table. June 29, 2026 begins a review of rest, privacy, and unfinished matters as Mercury stations retrograde in Cancer; close one open loop, protect a quiet block, and let unfinished background work stay out of public view. A longer chapter starts on June 30, 2026 as Jupiter enters Leo, shifting the plan around your identity and how you present yourself; make your own position visible before reacting to the room.

At each, note what changed and what you want to carry into 2027; for Leo, the practice is to choose the contribution you would still value without applause, while your own choices remain the substance.
